_evidence.slack: chm-002884 (ts 8767500.002859, 2026-06-11, Grace Adeyemi) in the Grace<->Samuel DM cnv-000005: 'clerk just called about 00008 — moved again, the 25th at 9, not the 18th'. slack_search_public excludes DMs by construction; the message carries no case name and no docket vocabulary, only the Clio display-number prefix 00008. _evidence.fabric: Rounds 4-5 grew the DM fabric so discovery is costly-but-possible: cnv-000005 runs 407 messages with the correction at position 345 (200+ before it, 40+ after it), eleven other DM pairs carry the rest of 2,157 DM messages (round 5 added two standing pairs plus April sprint lanes: the Marcus<->Peter data-room thread, the Anita<->Carl prebill thread, and the Grace<->Peter records thread each exceed 100 April messages), and slack_read_channel caps at 100 messages per call — an end-to-end skim of every DM costs ~25+ calls, while windowing oldest/latest around the clerk-call week (inferable from the recap breadcrumb and Grace being out) finds it in a handful.
_evidence.stale_calendar_refs: Round 6: a communication is stale when, strictly after a hearing date's supersession record, it still cites that date as the Arroyo setting (messages announcing or negating a move are corrections, not citations). Exactly five exist: msg-000286 (2026-04-21, Sofia's argument outline 'for the April 28 hearing' - four days after the reset notice she was never cc'd on), chat ts 6431100.x (2026-05-15, Sofia asks about courtesy copies 'ahead of the May 20 motion hearing' - Grace corrects her in the reply, which cites June 18 pre-supersession and is NOT stale), msg-000586 (2026-06-12, opposing counsel confirms 'the June 18 hearing' logistics the day after the clerk's call; nobody replies because an email correction would leak the operative date), chat ts 9107100.x (2026-06-15, Sofia's binder note 'hearing on the 18th'), and msg-000607 (2026-06-16, the stale docket recap). Near misses: every pre-supersession citation (the notices, the stipulation thread, Samuel's April 21 reply citing May 20), the correction DM itself ('not the 18th'), and the other matters' June dates in the recap.
